answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-reputation bond: every agent must lock a refundable deposit of 50,000 POA and earn trust only through verified work, like a garden that grows one seed at a time. A sybil attacker spinning up 1,000 fake agents would need 50 million POA locked up front, and a karst-like audit trail maps each agent's history in a public atlas, so clones with no past work are visible and slashed before they can vote. The cost scales linearly while the reward does not.
